exposure: Maternal anorexia nervosa (AN) (recent or past diagnosis)
Maternal bulimia nervosa (BN) (recent or past diagnosis)
Maternal eating disorder not otherwise specified (EDNOS) (recent or past diagnosis)
cohort: The study included 1,517,839 singletons born in Denmark between 1991 and 2015.
finding: Children born to mothers with eating disorders (EDs) have an increased risk of adverse neonatal outcomes, with more pronounced risks associated with recent rather than past maternal ED diagnoses.
